items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Miles Davis band--we had and Trane, Red, Paul and Philly Joe... Them guys get on stage there, boy. You know. look like they would be waiting for us... When Miles left town, somebody would have gone out of here. And we--so I--then I left for the Jazz Prophets--after that I quit the band.

ctx.x: This band with Dizzy and ya'll were in Pittsburgh.
Yeah. So everynight, uhm, I would I would look out in the audience and it would be Colrane , Miles, everybody standing up there looking at us, listening at us play.
